question:

Conclusions:

II. Q = B
options: Either conclusion I or II follows
Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow
explanation:
Read the chain B > Q ≤ Z ≥ H from Q to Z and from Q to B. A mix of > and < (or ≥ and ≤) between two letters breaks the link.
